table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	dbo.accounts.name , 
	dbo.accounts.aliasname,
	dbo.area.name,
	dbo.customercategory.name,
	dbo.customer.address1,
	dbo.customer.city,
	dbo.customer.country,
	dbo.customer.phone,
	dbo.customer.offphone,
	dbo.customer.fax,
	dbo.customer.email,
	dbo.customer.nic,
	dbo.customer.cp,
	dbo.customer.cp2,
	dbo.customer.licenceno,
	dbo.customer.licenceexpiry,
	area=area.name,
	subarea = (select sa.name from subarea sa where sa.subareacode=customer.subareacode),
	owner = customer.owner,
	taxcategory = (select tc.name from taxcategory tc where tc.taxcategorycode=customer.taxcategorycode),
	ntn = customer.ntnno,
	active = accounts.active
FROM 
	dbo.customer, 
	dbo.accounts, 
	dbo.area,
	dbo.customercategory
WHERE 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) and
	( dbo.area.areacode = dbo.customer.areacode ) and
	( dbo.area.areacode IN (:ai_areacode) ) and
	( dbo.customer.custcatcode = dbo.customercategory.custcatcode ) and
	( dbo.customercategory.custcatcode IN (:ai_custcatcode) )
ORDER BY
	dbo.area.name, 
	dbo.customercategory.name, 
	dbo.accounts.name ,
	dbo.accounts.aliasname,
	dbo.customer.address1 ,
	dbo.customer.city ,
	dbo.customer.country ,
	dbo.customer.phone
table.sort: area_name A, customercategory A, accounts_name A, aliasname A, customer_city A
